definitions.explanation: Describing actions or people that are disrespectful toward the gods, religion, or things considered sacred. Also used more loosely to mean "outrageous" or "shameful."

examples.japanese: {罰当|ばちあ}たりなこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧な。
⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{粗末|そまつ}→粗末：03323_somatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{罰当|ばちあ}たりだ。

⟦お{寺|てら}→お寺：23515_otera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{石像|せきぞう}→石像：17183_sekizou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いたずら→いたずら：01794_itazura⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{罰当|ばちあ}たり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ほど⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Vandalizing a temple statue is beyond sacrilegious.

notes:
FORMS:
{罰|ばち} (divine punishment) + ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧ (hitting, receiving). Literally "receiving divine punishment."

USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective ({罰当|ばちあ}たりな) or as a standalone noun. In everyday speech, it often expresses moral disapproval beyond strictly religious contexts — wasting food, disrespecting elders, or other "shameful" behavior.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {罰当|ばちあ}たりな⟦{行|おこな}い→行い：14121_okonai⟧ (sacrilegious conduct)
- {罰当|ばちあ}たりなこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say something impious)
- {罰|ばち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to receive divine punishment — the verb form)
